text:
maria: Heads-up — upstream released a patch set we need to triage: kubelet (CVE-2026-0421, priv esc via CRI), cert-manager (CVE-2026-0877, ACME key handling), and an etcd client dep CVE rated medium. Can we map impact to our clusters?

alex: Thanks. Quick wins first: prod-dedicated has kubelet 1.26.x, staging-prod is 1.25.x. Which versions are vulnerable?

maria: Kubelet fix requires 1.25.11+ and 1.26.4+. cert-manager has a patch release we can helm upgrade to. Etcd CVE is in a vendor client lib used by one sidecar (ingress controller).

jon: Priority suggestion: kubelet (high), cert-manager (high for cert issuance flows), etcd client (medium). For kubelet we should do node draining + kubelet restart; for cert-manager do canary helm upgrade in staging first.

sara: On RBAC + audit side: if we patch cert-manager, need to validate that new webhook perms match our PodSecurityPolicy/RBAC constraints. Also ensure audit logs capture ACME webhook failures. I can add an audit policy snippet to catch cert-manager webhooks failing.

cassie: KMS note: cert-manager upgrade may touch private key storage paths. We use KMS wrapping via our on-prem HSM for some clusters — need to confirm upgrade doesn't attempt to re-create or re-encrypt keys. Who owns KMS integration? @alex?

alex: I can validate. For private clusters using customer KMS we must avoid any automatic key rotations; we'll disable any key-bootstrap paths and run a preflight.

maria: Proposed rollout plan: 1) create a triage doc with per-cluster impact 2) run canary on non-prod with helm + restart sequence 3) for kubelet, patch node image (or kubelet systemd) + drain in small batches (5% nodes) 4) monitor audit logs, metrics, and SLOs 5) full rollout with automatic rollback on errors.

jon: Sounds good. Can we get a quick command sequence for kubelet nodes? E.g.:
```bash
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
ssh root@<node> 'systemctl restart kubelet'
kubectl uncordon <node>
```
We should also run node-level preflight: `kubelet --version` after restart.

maria: Add to that: check node kube-proxy and CNI plugin readiness, and ensure node labels for routing remain. Also verify our autoscaler doesn't try to replace drained nodes mid-upgrade.

cassie: Regarding RBAC: cert-manager 1.12 changed controller role names. We'll need a small helm values override to install ClusterRoleBindings we already manage via our infra repo. I can open a PR to infra/helm-values to pin the role names.

sara: For audit logging: I'll add a temporary rule to increase retention for cert-manager and kubelet audit events for 72h during rollout. We also should enable verbose authn/audit for kubelet restarts in canary.

maria: Backups: for etcd-related client lib, even if it's medium, let's snapshot backup etcd before ingress sidecar upgrades. Run: `ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot save /backups/etcd-$(date +%s).db` and verify restore in staging.

jon: Monitoring hooks: create SLO alerts for increased `apiserver_request_latencies`, kubelet `node_ready` flips, cert-manager `Certificate` failures, and ingress 5xx spikes. We'll link dashboards and add an incident runbook in case of cascading failures.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline queued: cert-manager-canary -> staging (helm 1.12.3), kubelet-patch -> kube-image-build, etcd-client-patch -> ingress-sidecar-image. CI tests: 120m ETA.

maria: Permissions check: list of actions for security review — (1) RBAC diff for cert-manager release (2) KMS integration checklist (disable auto key rewrap) (3) Audit policy bake-in (4) Backup verification for etcd. Assign owners and due times?

alex: I'll own KMS and cert-manager RBAC PRs. Due EOD tomorrow for canary.

cassie: I'll own infra helm-values PR and preflight.

sara: I'll push audit policy changes and set retention for 72h.

jon: I'll own monitoring/dashboards and runbook.

maria: Good — last thing: minimal user-facing impact plan. For kubelet patching, we'll limit to 5% nodes every 20m with a health check gate. If errors > 3% in a window or any SLO breach, abort. Add that to the canary job.

cassie: Noted — I'll add the abort condition to the rollout job (Argo).

maria: OK team — let's sync in #eng-oncall if anything spikes during canary. Post results here. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident watch enabled for this rollout window (canary). Alerts will be escalated per policy.
